killedBy: createRouteHost: Versus Setup reads the controllers already connected (issue #785) resolves Player 2 to a controller that was connected before the pane opened
why: Issue #785 itself: with no read on open, the pane resolves human slots against whatever pad list was last pushed, which is empty until the Controllers panel has been opened once. A controller connected before the pane opened reads "Unassigned" and Start is refused. The hotplug listeners still repair it on the next plug event, which is why only the connected-before-open case can fail.
